title: Who leads, and what the term is, on each member
note: An example cannot cut a link, so this is the healthy shape the stage compares against. The stage isolates whichever member this status call names as leader, lets the other two elect a successor in a higher term, and then heals. What must be true afterwards is that the isolated member reports the successor's id and the successor's term here, and the successor's value there — never the term or the value it was holding while it was alone.
